tools.name: animation_ik_bake
tools.description: Bake a three-bone IK chain to keys over a clip interval.

tools.name: animation_keys_edit
tools.description: Set, remove or retime keys in a named animation clip atomically.

tools.name: animation_remove
tools.description: Delete a named animation clip.

tools.name: animation_sample
tools.description: Animation sample. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: animation_set
tools.description: Animation set. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: animation_track_remove
tools.description: Remove a bone track from a named animation clip.

tools.name: animation_track_set
tools.description: Add or replace a bone track or update its interpolation.

tools.name: animation_update
tools.description: Update a named clip's duration or looping flag.

tools.name: bake_surface_map
tools.description: Bake a surface map by tracing from a target object to a source object.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Execute 1 to 1024 editor requests in order. Stops on the first failure and retains earlier successful edits.

tools.name: bevel_edges
tools.description: object, edges:[[a,b],...], positive width, segments:1..32. Use corner_mode:"isolated" for vertex-disjoint convex manifold edges with three incident faces at each endpoint.

tools.name: bevel_vertex
tools.description: vertex, optional fraction (default 0.1) Truncate a closed convex vertex fan with a plane, replacing the point with a cap

tools.name: bisect_plane
tools.description: object, normal, offset or offsets:[...] (up to 32): split convex planar faces at dot(unit(normal),position)=offset, retaining both sides. Intersection vertices are shared; the last cut is selected.

tools.name: bridge_faces
tools.description: faces: [a,b], optional offset Remove two end caps and join their equal-size boundary loops with quads

tools.name: bridge_loops
tools.description: object, loops:[[vertex IDs],[vertex IDs]], optional offset. Both closed boundaries must be disjoint and equally sized.

tools.name: capture
tools.description: Render the current scene with camera, visibility and diagnostic mode controls.

tools.name: capture_uv
tools.description: Explicit face/vertex corner values and scope Direct UV editing and validation; read help topic uv-editing-and-vertex-painting

tools.name: collection_create
tools.description: Collection create. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: collection_delete
tools.description: Collection delete. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: collection_update
tools.description: Change a named collection or its object membership.

tools.name: compare_reference
tools.description: Add layout:"overlay" for the cropped source with cyan mesh silhouette/projected contours, magenta reference contours/markers, and yellow residual lines. Default remains side-by-side.

tools.name: construction_apply
tools.description: Construction apply. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: construction_define
tools.description: Construction define. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: create_face
tools.description: object, ordered vertices:[...]. Fills one existing planar, simple closed boundary, including concave boundaries.

tools.name: cube
tools.description: Reset the mesh to the default cube. The edit is undoable.

tools.name: delete_faces
tools.description: Delete faces. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: dissolve_edges
tools.description: object, edges:[[a,b],...]. Dissolves the requested internal two-face edges sequentially.

tools.name: dissolve_region
tools.description: object, faces:[...] or region. Combines a connected, consistently wound planar patch with one boundary and no holes into an n-gon, retaining the lowest face ID and boundary vertices.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export the scene as OBJ, GLB, FBX or STL after workflow checks.

tools.name: export_verify
tools.description: Verify a workspace-local export file and return a verification receipt.

tools.name: extrude
tools.description: face or faces:[ids], plus value: [x,y,z] or signed nonzero distance Displace the cap and select its new vertices. Distance follows the unit normal implied by the face winding.

tools.name: extrude_polygon
tools.description: name (or destination object), points:[[u,v],...], positive depth, optional axis, center, origin, bevel, bevel_segments (1–16, default 3), holes. Require 0 <= bevel < depth/2 (strict upper bound; default 0).

tools.name: fit_reference
tools.description: reference, optional names:[calibration_landmarks], optional camera overrides. Orthographic: fits uniform scale/framing with at least two separated anchors.

tools.name: import_fbx
tools.description: path inside the active model workspace Append static binary or ASCII FBX polygon geometry as editable objects, undoable; preserves existing geometry and IDs

tools.name: import_obj
tools.description: path inside the active model workspace Append Wavefront OBJ polygon geometry as editable objects, undoable; preserves existing geometry and IDs

tools.name: import_glb
tools.description: path inside the active model workspace Append static GLB 2.0 triangle geometry as editable objects, undoable; preserves existing geometry and IDs

tools.name: improve_triangulation
tools.description: Improve triangulation. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: inset
tools.description: face, distance Offset a convex planar face's edges inward by a distance, creating a border ring

tools.name: inset_region
tools.description: Add a coplanar support ring inside a selected region.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Summarize mesh geometry, selection, validation and edit history.

tools.name: inspect_defects
tools.description: Inspect defects. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: inspect_loop
tools.description: Trace a regular closed quad edge loop.

tools.name: inspect_patch
tools.description: Read ordered perimeter IDs and positions for a connected mesh patch.

tools.name: inspect_profile
tools.description: Read points and measurements for an ordered source chain.

tools.name: inspect_region
tools.description: faces: [id,...] and/or vertices: [id,...], optional object, response:"full" Read-only local positions, face loops, neighbors, adjacency, bounds, boundary edges and disconnected-component count. Default collections may be summarized; full returns exact region data.

tools.name: inspect_shading
tools.description: face, faces, or object; optional coplanar:true grows one seed face across connected, consistently oriented coplanar neighbors. Reports per-face planarity, shading-normal deviation and triangle quality, with offending face/vertex IDs.

tools.name: inspect_uv
tools.description: Explicit face/vertex corner values and scope Direct UV editing and validation; read help topic uv-editing-and-vertex-painting

tools.name: inspect_volume
tools.description: Inspect volume. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: intersection_allow
tools.description: Intersection allow. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List saved mesh workspaces visible to the configured editor or project viewer.

tools.name: load
tools.description: Replace the current mesh with a native project object, version 1 through 9.

tools.name: loft
tools.description: Join ordered cross sections into a mesh surface.

tools.name: measure_clearance
tools.description: Measure clearance. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: move
tools.description: Translate selected vertices by an XYZ offset.

tools.name: move_in_reference
tools.description: reference, required revision and alignment_version from project_reference. landmark:"name" moves its bound vertices rigidly to the target; optional delta_pixels requests a partial/custom move.

tools.name: move_in_view
tools.description: Current selection or explicit vertices, delta_pixels:[dx,dy], view_id or explicit camera:{yaw,pitch,zoom,center,width,height}. Deltas use actual capture pixels.

tools.name: move_vertices
tools.description: object, offsets:[{vertex,delta:[x,y,z]},...] Apply distinct vertex offsets in one edit. See local-sculpting

tools.name: object_add_box
tools.description: Add box geometry to an existing object.

tools.name: object_create_box
tools.description: Create a separate box object from its bounds.

tools.name: object_delete
tools.description: Delete an object and its geometry.

tools.name: object_delete_components
tools.description: Object delete components. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: object_duplicate
tools.description: Source object, unique destination name, optional translation value:[x,y,z]. Independent copy preserving face winding, smoothing and flat-face overrides; translates the source pivot with the geometry.

tools.name: object_instance
tools.description: Master object, unique name, optional translation value:[x,y,z] Create a linked copy; master shape, topology and shading edits propagate

tools.name: object_join
tools.description: Object join. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: object_link_instance
tools.description: Convert existing geometry into a linked copy of an independent master.

tools.name: object_make_unique
tools.description: object Detach a copy, preserving its placement, pivot, geometry IDs and collections

tools.name: object_move
tools.description: object, value: [x,y,z] or align Translate the object's vertices and origin together

tools.name: object_profile
tools.description: Generate a profile object along an ordered source chain.

tools.name: object_rename
tools.description: object, name Set a unique object name

tools.name: object_review_check
tools.description: object, check, outcome, reason, optional evidence Record a review result against the object’s checklist

tools.name: object_review_plan
tools.description: object, checks Replace the object’s checklist and reopen its review

tools.name: object_rotate
tools.description: object, value: [x,y,z], optional pivot:[x,y,z] or pivot:"bounds_center" Rotate all object vertices in incremental degrees, X then Y then Z. Defaults to its origin.

tools.name: object_scale
tools.description: Object scale. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: object_separate_faces
tools.description: Object separate faces. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: object_set_origin
tools.description: object, origin: [x,y,z] Set pivot without moving vertices

tools.name: object_set_stage
tools.description: object, stage, optional note Record progress. Production ready requires a completed object review and a note

tools.name: project_reference
tools.description: Read saved view: projected points, target-to-mesh deltas, RMS/max errors in original-image pixels. Optional names, offset, limit 1..64 (default 16).

tools.name: quad_strip
tools.description: Connect ordered contours with a strip of quad faces.

tools.name: query_animation
tools.description: Page through clips, tracks or a track's exact keyframes.

tools.name: query_boundaries
tools.description: object, optional pagination. Returns ordered closed boundary loops and branching vertices.

tools.name: query_components
tools.description: Query components. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: query_constructions
tools.description: Page through saved parameterized construction definitions.

tools.name: query_instance
tools.description: Instance object, kind:"vertices" or "faces", optional ids, offset, limit Paginated master-ID to instance-ID mapping; ids filters by instance IDs

tools.name: query_mesh
tools.description: Page through current vertices, faces, objects or selection.

tools.name: query_object_review
tools.description: object Read the checklist, recorded outcomes and stage

tools.name: query_record
tools.description: Read a paginated field from a recorded result.

tools.name: query_reviews
tools.description: Page through saved review presets.

tools.name: query_rig
tools.description: List bones, skin weight counts and animation clips.

tools.name: query_texture_faces
tools.description: Preview the face scope with optional object, faces or region, filter, offset and limit. Add seed_face and expand:"connected" to follow shared edges, or expand:"uv_island" to follow only edges with matching UVs at both corners.

tools.name: query_texture_layers
tools.description: texture, optional revision, offset, limit (1–256, default 32). Exact layer metadata and masks, image dimensions without pixel payloads, channel names and height-to-normal settings.

tools.name: query_texture_masks
tools.description: texture, optional revision, offset, limit. Exact paged definitions in name order, including references, filters and transform.

tools.name: query_uv
tools.description: Explicit face/vertex corner values and scope Direct UV editing and validation; read help topic uv-editing-and-vertex-painting

tools.name: query_vertex_colors
tools.description: Vertex IDs and normalized RGB Direct vertex painting, exact queries and capture with mode:"vertex_colors"

tools.name: radial_offset
tools.description: Offset selected vertices radially while preserving their positions along the axis.

tools.name: radial_profile
tools.description: axis, optional center, profile:[[axial_position,radial_offset],...]: linearly interpolated radial displacement on the current selection. Samples must increase in axial position relative to center; outside their span geometry is unchanged.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Reapply the last undone document snapshot.

tools.name: reference_guides
tools.description: Convert image-space traces to camera rays and emit an SVG or JSON artifact. Optional world-to-pixel anchors fit a camera.

tools.name: reference_landmarks
tools.description: reference, landmarks:[{name,pixel:[x,y],vertices:[ids],object?},...], optional contours:[{landmarks:[names],closed:true}]. A binding with only object uses its vertex centroid.

tools.name: reference_view
tools.description: Save camera and crop settings for a registered reference.

tools.name: regenerate_component
tools.description: object, region, optional overrides containing generator arguments. Re-evaluates the saved recipe from current source geometry.

tools.name: region_define
tools.description: Save a named set of mesh faces.

tools.name: region_remove
tools.description: Remove a named saved region.

tools.name: relax_surface
tools.description: Relax surface. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: replace_patch
tools.description: Replace a connected patch while preserving its ordered perimeter.

tools.name: replay
tools.description: Read a local CLI recording and optionally select a zero-based frame.

tools.name: retriangulate_region
tools.description: Same region selection; requires one consistently wound planar patch with one simple boundary. Triangulates polygons and flips internal diagonals when the minimum quality of the two affected triangles improves.

tools.name: review_define
tools.description: Review define. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: review_run
tools.description: Review run. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: review_update
tools.description: Update a named saved review preset.

tools.name: revolve
tools.description: name (or destination object), profile, segments (8–512), optional axis (X/Y/Z, default Y), center, origin, start (degrees), sweep (greater than 0, at most 360), closed_profile. Creates shared rings, welded poles and a welded full-sweep seam.

tools.name: rig_clear
tools.description: Remove the rig, skin weights and animation clips.

tools.name: rig_display_tails_set
tools.description: Rig display tails set. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: rig_rotation_limits_set
tools.description: Rig rotation limits set. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: rig_set
tools.description: Rig set. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: rotate
tools.description: Rotate selected vertices about their centroid in XYZ degrees.

tools.name: save
tools.description: Return the current native mesh project as an artifact or full JSON.

tools.name: scale
tools.description: Scale selected vertices about their centroid.

tools.name: sculpt_stroke
tools.description: object, mode, radius, strength, samples:[{face,barycentric},...], optional max_displacement, direction:[x,y,z], continuous:true Raise or lower a connected neighborhood on a triangulated surface. See local-sculpting

tools.name: select
tools.description: Replace the current selection with vertex IDs or a collection.

tools.name: select_box
tools.description: Select vertices within inclusive XYZ bounds.

tools.name: select_collection
tools.description: Select collection. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: select_image
tools.description: Select vertices in a rectangle in capture pixel coordinates.

tools.name: select_loop
tools.description: Trace a regular closed quad edge loop and select its vertices.

tools.name: select_object
tools.description: object Select all vertices owned by this object

tools.name: select_region
tools.description: Select vertices that belong to a saved mesh region.

tools.name: select_related
tools.description: Select topology or mirrored geometry related to a seed.

tools.name: shade_region
tools.description: Same region selection; mode:"flat" overrides selected face corners with geometric normals, mode:"smooth" removes that override and resumes object shading. Other faces retain their existing shading.

tools.name: shade_smooth
tools.description: object, angle (0–180 degrees, default 60): crease-controlled, angle-weighted corner normals in CPU captures, WebGL and native FBX. Zero restores flat normals.

tools.name: skin_weights_set
tools.description: Skin weights set. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: solid_boolean
tools.description: base, tools:[...] (1–64 distinct object IDs), and operation of union, difference, or intersection. Combines closed, outward-wound solids in tool order and reports the volume in cubic mesh units.

tools.name: split_edge
tools.description: edge: [a,b], optional fraction (default 0.5) Insert a vertex into every face sharing the edge; select new vertex

tools.name: split_face
tools.description: face, vertices: [a,b] Split a convex planar polygon with a diagonal between non-adjacent vertices

tools.name: split_vertices
tools.description: faces: [id,...], optional vertices Duplicate shared vertices for these faces, separating them from other faces

tools.name: stretch_band
tools.description: Stretch band. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: subdivision_surface
tools.description: Evaluate a Catmull-Clark surface from a source object and optional crease edges.

tools.name: sweep
tools.description: name or destination object, simple closed profile:[[u,v],...], path:[[x,y,z],...], optional up (default X), scales:[[u,v],...] per path point. Sweeps capped sections with transported frames and triangulated sides.

tools.name: taper
tools.description: Apply piecewise scales perpendicular to an axis on the current selection.

tools.name: texture_assign
tools.description: Named image resources and face assignments Direct texture mapping and PNG export; see the same appearance help topic

tools.name: texture_bake
tools.description: Recompute layered textures with optional stack flattening.

tools.name: texture_bake_normals
tools.description: Bake mesh normals to a texture.

tools.name: texture_create
tools.description: texture, width, height (1–1024), color:[r,g,b,a] in 0–1. Creates a solid image; rejects an existing name.

tools.name: texture_define
tools.description: Named image resources and face assignments Direct texture mapping and PNG export; see the same appearance help topic

tools.name: texture_export
tools.description: Named image resources and face assignments Direct texture mapping and PNG export; see the same appearance help topic

tools.name: texture_import
tools.description: Named image resources and face assignments Direct texture mapping and PNG export; see the same appearance help topic

tools.name: texture_layer_add
tools.description: texture, layer:{name,channel?,color?,opacity?,blend?,visible?,mask?}. Channel defaults to base_color; color to white RGBA; opacity to 1; blend to normal; visible to true.

tools.name: texture_layer_capture
tools.description: texture, layer. Read-only grayscale mask PNG using the usual artifact reply and CLI --output mask.png.

tools.name: texture_layer_mask_faces
tools.description: texture, layer, optional object, faces, filter; mode:"faces" (default) or "boundary". Replaces the mask with filled UV polygons or strokes along edges incident to exactly one face in the requested set.

tools.name: texture_layer_move
tools.description: Move a texture layer to a zero-based index.

tools.name: texture_layer_paint
tools.description: Append UV brush strokes to a texture layer mask.

tools.name: texture_layer_remove
tools.description: Remove a layer and recomposite the texture.

tools.name: texture_layer_set
tools.description: texture, layer:"name", changes:{color?,opacity?,blend?,visible?,mask?}. Mask changes merge named fields into the existing mask, so adjusting noise preserves strokes/polygons.

tools.name: texture_map_set
tools.description: Snapshot another registered image as a texture channel base.

tools.name: texture_mask_capture
tools.description: texture, name. Read-only grayscale PNG of the resolved definition.

tools.name: texture_mask_paint
tools.description: texture, name, strokes:[...]. Appends mask strokes using the existing UV radius/hardness/opacity/value schema.

tools.name: texture_mask_remove
tools.description: texture, name. Deletes an unreferenced named mask.

tools.name: texture_mask_set
tools.description: texture, name, mask:{...}. Creates or replaces a named definition.

tools.name: texture_mask_stamp
tools.description: texture, name, source_texture, center:[u,v], size:[u,v], optional rotation, opacity (1), value (1). Snapshots the registered image's baked base color as a brush alpha.

tools.name: texture_mask_surface
tools.description: Set a named mask with texture, name, a complete shape, and the same optional scope and expansion fields. Reissuing the command without a scope keeps the existing position/UV snapshot.

tools.name: texture_mask_transform
tools.description: texture, name, optional offset:[u,v], scale:[u,v], center:[u,v] (default [0.5,0.5]), rotation in counterclockwise degrees. Sets an absolute transform; omitted values reset to identity.

tools.name: texture_normal_from_height
tools.description: texture, strength (0–64, or null to disable). Derives a tangent-space normal map after compositing height.

tools.name: texture_remove
tools.description: Remove an unassigned texture.

tools.name: texture_settings
tools.description: Update the material's texture filter or sidedness.

tools.name: thicken
tools.description: Thicken. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: transaction
tools.description: Preview or atomically commit supported editor edits. Supply commands or commit an existing preview using its ID and revision.

tools.name: triangulate
tools.description: object: triangulate convex planar polygons, preserving each source face ID for its first triangle.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Restore the previous document snapshot.

tools.name: uv_clear
tools.description: Explicit face/vertex corner values and scope Direct UV editing and validation; read help topic uv-editing-and-vertex-painting

tools.name: uv_pack
tools.description: Repack existing UV islands while preserving mesh topology.

tools.name: uv_project
tools.description: Generate planar, box or cylindrical UV coordinates for a face scope.

tools.name: uv_set
tools.description: Write UV values to selected face corners or to all in-scope corners of a vertex.

tools.name: uv_transform
tools.description: Explicit face/vertex corner values and scope Direct UV editing and validation; read help topic uv-editing-and-vertex-painting

tools.name: uv_unwrap
tools.description: Select an object, faces, or named region. Optionally pass seams:[[a,b],...], square atlas resolution (16–4096, default 1024), and padding in pixels (default 2).

tools.name: version
tools.description: Return the CLI version and supported wrapper features.

tools.name: vertex_color_clear
tools.description: Vertex IDs and normalized RGB Direct vertex painting, exact queries and capture with mode:"vertex_colors"

tools.name: vertex_color_gradient
tools.description: Explicit scopes, mapping bounds and paint parameters Optional coordinate/normal operations; read help topic native-appearance-recipes; use CLI --batch for JSON command recipes

tools.name: vertex_color_set
tools.description: Set per-vertex RGB values, or apply one RGB value to a list of vertex IDs.

tools.name: vertex_color_shade
tools.description: Explicit scopes, mapping bounds and paint parameters Optional coordinate/normal operations; read help topic native-appearance-recipes; use CLI --batch for JSON command recipes

tools.name: visual_hull
tools.description: Build an approximate outer volume from segmented camera views and write OBJ or native project JSON.

tools.name: weld
tools.description: optional vertices, target, position: [x,y,z] Merge vertices, repair face loops and remove collapsed faces; select survivor

tools.name: weld_coincident
tools.description: Weld coincident. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: workflow_assess
tools.description: requirement, assessment, required evidence:[resource_id,...], optional object. Reference needs reference evidence; primary forms a capture; views two distinct camera records; export validation report/evidence.

tools.name: workflow_part_plan
tools.description: Workflow part plan. See atk-mesh help for command details.

tools.name: workflow_reopen
tools.description: requirement, reason, optional object; explicitly exempt or reset a check.

tools.name: workflow_report
tools.description: Generate a Markdown report of the workspace review workflow.

tools.name: workflow_resource
tools.description: kind:"capture", trace session, event, description, optional object. Derives path/camera from a successful capture/comparison and verifies its source snapshot matches current geometry.

tools.name: workflow_stage
tools.description: Advance to a workflow stage after its requirements are satisfied.

tools.name: workflow_status
tools.description: Requirements and paged resources: offset, limit 1..64, default 8.

tools.name: workflow_waive
tools.description: requirement, reason, optional object; explicitly exempt or reset a check.
